item.title: Douglas County high schoolers invited to enter annual Lawrence Juneteenth writing contest

item.title: Lawrence City Commission lifts cap on short-term rentals for duration of World Cup
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners have approved a change to remove the limit on how many short-term rental units — such as AirBnBs — property owners may hold. The change will be in place throughout the World Cup. Continue reading ...
